what: Two on one. Target: Skaven clanrats_1 (160, shields), its morale kept; 'deep' ordered 30 m wide (at the go 31 x 15 m, at the hammer's contact ~29 x 12 m), 'shallow' ordered 45 m wide (at the go 45 x 11 m, at the hammer's contact ~37 x 13-16 m: it closed in round the 30 m anvil). Anvil: Empire spearmen_0 (30 m, fearless) 1.5 m off its front, both attack each other at a walk at the go. Hammer: Empire swordsmen (30 m, fearless) on the anvil's line 48 m to its right (centre to centre); flank / rear / front go at the go (at a run) to their approach point - 20 m (edge to edge) off the target's right flank / round the flank to 20 m behind its back / beside the anvil (2 m between edges) - place stays; all attack at a run 20 s after the anvil's first melee flag; stand never moves. Times s, health shares of each unit's starting health, from ref = the hammer's first melee flag (stand: anvil contact + 25 s). trade = target lost - ours lost (anvil + hammer, share of their joint start). Normal difficulty, flat field, 5 lanes a battle 400+ m apart, 8 battles (battles 1-2 without memory morale rows). Memory (memreader): the target's morale effects, its contact list's side of each attacker (0 front / 1 flank / 2 rear), its fight outcome state (unit + 0x3640); the anvil's and the hammer's outcome are not read (the entry polls the targets' morale only).
stats: summary: [mean, standard error, n] over lanes; paired_*: difference to 'stand' (game: in the same battle; twin: to the twin's stand mean)
sim: twin = charge_probe.sim_lanes on the game's recorded starts, 8 copies a lane; pred = the same on the plan's own places, run before the game (17:41, tmp/flank2v1/pred_head.json). Both on the simulator at commit 69db105 (clean checkout; the uncommitted morale edits in the working tree not included). Re-run: python -m game.probe.unit_probe --flank2v1 game <runs> --sim (container: bash ops/dock.sh ...)
